model_annotation: The plot illustrates the coverage achieved by four different language model configurations—Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT—as a function of the number of completions (k), which is displayed on a logarithmic scale ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and uses powers of two as tick labels, with a logarithmic scale. The y-axis, labeled "Coverage," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with linear spacing and tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The blue solid line with circular markers represents Llama-3B, starting at approximately 0.42 coverage at k=2⁰ and increasing to about 0.88 at k=2⁸. The dark green dashed line with triangular markers for Llama-3B + FT begins at roughly 0.43 and rises to approximately 0.90 at k=2⁸. The light blue dotted line with diamond markers for Llama-1B starts at about 0.25 and reaches approximately 0.83 at k=2⁸. The light green dash-dotted line with star markers for Llama-1B + FT begins at around 0.26 and increases to about 0.85 at k=2⁸. All four lines show a consistent upward trend in coverage as the number of completions increases, with the two Llama-3B variants achieving higher coverage than the Llama-1B variants across all k values.
